_about: PARKED: a launch ender for any blow of a string (docs/combat/launch-enders.md; Orb, 2026-10-16: launchers can start and be aimed at any point in a string). For each fighter: his last blow's family (limb group: hands, legs, close) and path, and the send the stick asks, give his launch pieces in order. step 1: its path follows the last one (parts.json strike.links) and it is his family; 2: it follows; 3: his family, with a re-chamber; 4: any, with a re-chamber; 5: the step lower, a medium that sends that way. A re-chamber is the tell made longer by the join, so it is always there and always readable. The alchemist picks within a step (section 3 of the note). Not loaded or hashed
_launchLinks: a string's links (parts.json strike.links) plus what a launch can follow that a string doesn't: the hook into the uppercut or the hammer, the spin into a rise or a fall, the outward arc into a rise
